profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at GE Healthcare
profile.summary: Software Developer with formal training in Mathematics and experience in graphics, simulation, and visualization. I've been developing software for ~10 years, and have proven experience applying mathematical and algorithmic knowledge to address novel challenges in R&D settings. Generally, my background is well suited to problems dealing with shape or dynamics.

positions.title: Indie Game Developer
positions.description:
• Developed iOS arcade game Meltdown, released August 2023.
• This is an independent creative outlet where I develop indie games

positions.title: Staff Software Developer, Innovation
positions.description:
• Developed experimental “phygital” system to power real-time interactive design experience.
• Developed spatial algorithm for stable real-time translation of designs captured via camera feed.
• Supported maintenance and improvement of internally developed design software.

positions.title: Design Technologist
positions.description:
• Led development for custom design software, resulting in viable alternatives for tools costing up to $150,000 per year, $2,800/user, or tools with no commercial alternative.
• Developed system for extracting BIM data from designs, collecting ~50,000 detailed snapshots per year. Over 1 billion records processed in the first 1.5 years of operation.
• Architect for Data Warehousing efforts, led R&D into ML and Digital Twin applications.
• Developed workflows and tools for displaying and understanding trends in detailed BIM data.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Simulation
positions.description:
• Main developer on the Simularium Project – a web-native 3D visualization system for cell biology.
• Responsible for system architecture, development plan, and implementation.
• Developed multi-threaded server capable of live-streaming simulations via web-sockets.
• Developed API for integrating existing simulation engines into streaming server.
• Developed WebGL front-end capable of displaying 3D simulations in a web-browser.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Linear Algebra · Vector Calculus · 3D Math

positions.title: Software Engineer, R&D
positions.description:
• R&D related to performance of the Windows OS on prototype devices.
• Learned about best practices and working with large code-bases.

positions.title: Game Programmer, Graphics & Gameplay
positions.description:
• Developer on Tyto Ecology, an ecosystem simulation game released on iOS, Mac, and PC.
• Developer on Tyto Online, an MMO game teaching STEM concepts, on Mac & PC.
• Implemented static mesh instancing system that improved performance 1000x on mobile hardware.
• Implemented features and fixes for multi-threaded animal AI and animation-state-machines.
• Implemented networked game-play features. Regularly performed performance profiling and tuning.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Unreal Engine · Linear Algebra · Vector Calculus · 3D Math

projects.title: Publizoid Meltdown
projects.description: An arcade game for iOS, developed independently.

projects.title: Simularium
projects.description: A web-native system for viewing multi-scale bio-molecular simulations on the web. I was involved from the initial technical design through to the deployment of the Simularium Viewer.

publications.title: Integrated intracellular organization and its variations in human iPS cells
The Simularium Viewer: an interactive online tool for sharing spatiotemporal biological models
